name: Dossier
description: Renders the docs vault in Obsidian's reading view: refined typography, tables, callouts, code and task-lists; mermaid re-rendered as framed ELK diagram cards; a rich-viz dashboard block; a document masthead, table-of-contents and floating section-nav; and a theme switcher (Auto/Paper/Ink/Slate). The editor also picks up the dossier fonts and palette (on by default, toggleable). Never modifies your notes.
author: AI Engineering
